steps.title: [S1] US-1 (A1 workaround): pick a Power Tools product rated better than E from the unfiltered list
[S1] US-2: the detail page matches the selected product

[S1] US-3: checkout asks for a login; log in as Jane Doe
[S1] US-3: enter the billing address and reach the payment step
[S1] US-4: before paying, add the Excavator for 10 hours at rate × 10

[S2] cart: subtotal, 15 % combination discount and total (A5, A6)
[S1] US-4: pay by Bank Transfer; the order is confirmed with an invoice number
[S2] the cart is cleared after the order (S2 Payment AC9)
[S1] US-3/US-4: the invoice of this order lists the product × 2 and the Excavator × 10 h
[S2] invoice: subtotal, 15 % discount and total (S2 Combination Discount AC4)
